title: Codebase Audit & Cleanup — Full-Stack Review 2026
summary: Comprehensive codebase audit covering file hygiene, code quality, test coverage, and dependency health. All findings organized by severity for phased implementation.

commits.title: chore: delete temp and build artifact files
commits.description: Remove page-output.txt, not-found-preview.png, tsconfig.tsbuildinfo (root + studio), amplify.yml

commits.title: chore: delete leftover .astro directory
commits.description: Remove entire .astro/ directory — leftover from a prior Astro framework, project is Next.js

commits.title: chore: delete studio build artifacts and stale data
commits.description: Remove studio/dist/, studio/data_downloads/data.ndjson, studio/data_downloads/production-backup.tar.gz, studio/data/exports/, studio/pnpm-lock.yaml

commits.title: chore: delete redundant boilerplate files
commits.description: Remove SUPPORT.md (redundant with CONTRIBUTING.md) and CHANGELOG.dev.md (stale dev branch log)

commits.title: refactor: delete orphaned lib modules with zero imports
commits.description: Remove src/lib/local-cache.ts, src/lib/seo-image.ts, src/lib/cms-data.ts — all have zero production imports

commits.title: refactor: delete orphaned SEO types and superseded ProjectCard
commits.description: Remove src/components/seo/types.ts (zero imports) and src/components/ui/ProjectCard.tsx (only imported in tests, superseded by inline implementations)

commits.title: refactor: delete orphaned CMS barrel module
commits.description: Remove src/components/cms/ directory (index.ts, sanity-field.lib.ts, sanity-field.types.ts, SanityField.tsx) — zero external imports, superseded by src/utils/sanity-data-attribute.ts. Update test that imports from it.

commits.title: docs: remove stale Sanity planning docs
commits.description: Remove docs/sanity-import-plan.md (completed import), docs/sanity_plans/ directory (18 completed planning files), studio/PLAN.md (completed restructuring)

commits.title: docs: remove stale react-doctor historical reports
commits.description: Remove docs/react-doctor/baseline.txt, epic-3-report.md, epic-4-report.md, epic-5-report.md, PR_NOTES.md, triage.md — keep only scoreboard.md and score.md

commits.title: docs: remove translated README files
commits.description: Remove docs/README_de.md, docs/README_es.md, docs/README_fr.md, docs/README_ja.md, docs/README_ko.md, docs/README_pt.md, docs/README_ru.md, docs/README_zh.md — no evidence of international contributors

commits.title: docs: remove stale misc docs
commits.description: Remove docs/about-section-preview.md (one-time artifact), docs/CONTINUATION_PROMPT.md (stale session prompt with wrong path), studio/prd/ (completed epic PRDs)

commits.title: fix(security): add sandbox attribute to ResumeModal iframe
commits.description: Add sandbox="allow-same-origin" to the ResumeModal iframe for security hardening

commits.title: fix(types): replace any type in BlogPostContent with proper Components type
commits.description: Replace `const markdownComponents: any = {...}` with proper react-markdown Components type in src/components/blog/BlogPostContent.tsx

commits.title: fix(types): remove double cast window.open hack in ChatPanel
commits.description: Replace `(window.open as unknown as ...)` double-cast with a proper typed wrapper or eslint-disable comment in src/components/ui/ChatPanel.tsx

commits.title: fix(code): replace var declaration with proper globalThis typing in media.ts
commits.description: Replace `var __resolveContentImageSrc_cache` with a properly typed module-level Map using declare global or a module-scoped variable

commits.title: fix(react): add prefers-reduced-motion guard to MagicCursor
commits.description: Check window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') and skip cursor trail animation when user prefers reduced motion

commits.title: fix(react): remove no-op useMemo in useCmsContent
commits.description: Remove `useMemo(() => value, [value])` which provides no caching benefit in src/hooks/useCmsContent.tsx

commits.title: fix(style): normalize quote style in MagicCursor imports
commits.description: Change double quotes to single quotes in MagicCursor.tsx imports for consistency with codebase

commits.title: fix(config): remove deprecated --ext flag from lint script
commits.description: Change ESLint script from `eslint src studio --ext .ts,.tsx,.js,.jsx` to `eslint src studio` since ESLint 9 flat config ignores --ext

commits.title: fix(config): update vitest coverage config to remove as any
commits.description: Fix the `as any` type assertion in vitest.config.ts coverage config

commits.title: docs: update .env.example with missing variables
commits.description: Add REDIS_CACHE_URL, REDIS_CACHE_TOKEN, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN, NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_STUDIO_URL, SANITY_STUDIO_URL to .env.example

commits.title: fix(deps): remove unused styled-components from root package.json
commits.description: Remove styled-components from root dependencies (studio has its own copy). Remove unused @sanity/functions from root devDependencies.

commits.title: test: run full test suite and fix any failures
commits.description: Run npm run lint, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run test -- --run. Fix any failures caused by deleted files or code changes.

commits.title: feat(security): create bot-blocker utility with detection patterns
commits.description: Create src/lib/bot-blocker.ts with known malicious user-agent signatures, empty UA detection, scanner/bot pattern matching. Returns HTTP 418 (I'm a teapot) to block unwanted automated scrapers.

commits.title: feat(security): integrate bot-blocker into middleware
commits.description: Update src/middleware.ts to call bot-blocker on every request. Block known scrapers, empty UAs, and unauthorized traffic with HTTP 418.

commits.title: feat(security): add global rate limiting to API routes
commits.description: Extend middleware to apply rate limiting to all API routes (not just chat). Use Upstash Redis with in-memory fallback. 30 requests per 60s per IP for general API, 10 per 60s for chat.

commits.title: test(security): add bot-blocker unit tests
commits.description: Write tests for bot-blocker utility: known bad UAs, empty UA, good UAs pass through, rate limiter logic.

commits.title: chore(deps): install husky, lint-staged, commitlint, gitleaks
commits.description: Install husky (git hooks), lint-staged (run linters on staged files), @commitlint/cli + @commitlint/config-conventional (commit message enforcement), and gitleaks-cli (secret scanning).

commits.title: chore(config): add .editorconfig for consistent editor settings
commits.description: Create .editorconfig with indent_style=space, indent_size=2, trim_trailing_whitespace, insert_final_newline. Ensures all contributors use consistent formatting.

commits.title: chore(config): configure lint-staged in package.json
commits.description: Add lint-staged config to run ESLint + Prettier on staged .ts/.tsx files, and Prettier on .json/.css/.md files. Prevents committing unlinted code.

commits.title: chore(config): create commitlint config
commits.description: Create commitlint.config.mjs with @commitlint/config-conventional. Enforces conventional commit format (type(scope): subject). Prevents bad commit messages.

commits.title: feat(git): create pre-commit hook
commits.description: Create .husky/pre-commit hook that runs: (1) lint-staged, (2) gitleaks detect for secret scanning, (3) npx tsc --noEmit for type checking. Blocks commits that fail any check.

commits.title: feat(git): create commit-msg hook
commits.description: Create .husky/commit-msg hook that runs commitlint against the commit message. Blocks commits with non-conventional format.

commits.title: chore(config): add prepare script to package.json
commits.description: Add `prepare: husky` script so hooks are automatically installed on npm install. Also add gitleaks to devDependencies.

commits.title: test(guardrails): verify all hooks work correctly
commits.description: Test: (1) pre-commit blocks bad code, (2) commit-msg blocks bad messages, (3) gitleaks catches secrets, (4) lint-staged runs ESLint, (5) tsc catches type errors.
